test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Swapnil can build a sofa in 16 days. Working together with Revathi he can finish the work in 128/17 days. Find the number of days taken by Revathi to complete the work if she works alone.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Combined work rate:

⇒ 1/(128/17) = 17/128 (sofas per day)

Sum of individual work rates:

⇒ 1/16 + 1/R = 17/128

Solving for R:

⇒ 1/16 + 1/R = 17/128

⇒ 1/R = 17/128 - 1/16

⇒ 1/R = 17/128 - 8/128

⇒ 1/R = 9/128

⇒ R = 128/9

**∴ The number of days taken by Revathi to complete the work alone is 128/9 days.**
